definitions.explanation: The style or design of written characters, whether in calligraphy, printing, or digital fonts. Covers both traditional calligraphic styles and modern digital typefaces.

examples.japanese: {書体|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧{書体|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}います→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which typeface will you use for this document?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楷書|かいしょ}→楷書：13247_kaisho⟧や⟦{行書|ぎょうしょ}→行書：19195_gyousho⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、さまざまな{書体|しょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese has various script styles such as block script and semi-cursive.

notes:
{書体|しょたい} refers to the style or design of written characters, covering both traditional calligraphic styles and modern digital typefaces.

TRADITIONAL STYLES:
- ⟦{楷書|かいしょ}→楷書：13247_kaisho⟧: block script (standard, clear strokes)
- ⟦{行書|ぎょうしょ}→行書：19195_gyousho⟧: semi-cursive script
- ⟦{草書|そうしょ}→草書：19196_sousho⟧: cursive script

MODERN TYPEFACES:
- ⟦{明朝体|みんちょうたい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧: Ming/serif typeface
- ⟦ゴシック{体|たい}→ゴシック体：26661_goshikkutai⟧: Gothic/sans-serif typeface

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書体|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a typeface
- {書体|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the font
- {書体|しょたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of typefaces

SIMILAR WORDS:
The loanword ⟦フォント→フォント：20915_fonto⟧ (font) is commonly used in digital contexts and is nearly interchangeable with {書体|しょたい} when referring to computer fonts.
